messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

You can now enter an optional game name under **Reproduce a game** before exporting progress. The name returns when you load the snapshot. Older unnamed saves still work.

Snapshot loading also accepts valid JSON properties in any order, fixing the imports that failed when `version` wasn’t first.

Verification passed: type checks, 141 unit and static tests, and all 78 browser tests. The changed files pass formatting checks; the repository-wide formatting check reports three pre-existing, untouched files.
